_template.purpose: Coordinator-owned execution decision and evidence record. Not a scheduler, native receipt, implementation mandate or product PASS.
instantiation: Replace every double-brace placeholder using placeholder_inventory; parse raw and substituted JSON with duplicate-key rejection. Rebase template-relative links for the instantiated project location.

Unknown observations remain JSON null, not empty strings, zero, guessed identities, timestamps, hashes or success. Record reason, observation time, consequence and resolution route in unknowns. Explicit absence and inapplicability require their own disposition and evidence.

False eligibility/completion flags mean this new record has not established a gate, not an observed provider failure. Empty collections are unpopulated, never proof of no findings, dependencies, tasks or retained resources; record inventory completeness separately.

collection_shapes describes rows to append only when evidenced. Shapes and enum inventories are metadata, not example executions. Copy the full task shape for each actual task, including document-only tasks; use reasoned applicability records instead of invented runtime receipts.

Keep actual host paths, owner/chat/Run/Task/Dispatch identities, model routes, native receipts and command details in private project bindings. Evidence pointers resolve to immutable repository-relative path/hash/provenance records; export neither credentials nor hidden reasoning.

The designated execution-owner chat alone writes STATE, TODO, EVENTS and campaign native state. Logis owns canonical PLANNING_STATE; bind its accepted immutable snapshot without creating a competing planning writer. Workers write only assigned source and evidence.

On each shared-state change preserve the preceding record and event, increment revision and record aware UTC. Use same-directory temporary write, flush/fsync where available and atomic replacement; retain prior usable state if parsing or replacement fails. State and external actions are not one transaction.

Remove _template from operational state after retaining its version and binding externally. This file's own hash belongs in an external receipt, never inside the file it hashes. Mutable STATE, TODO, EVENTS and PLANNING_STATE are excluded from the frozen input manifest.

schema_version 1 names this staged acd-orca template family, not legacy acd schema 1 or 2. Preserve legacy originals and reconcile authority, admission, identity, provider, source and clocks explicitly; never relabel legacy data or manufacture missing receipts.

placeholder_inventory.campaign_name: English lowercase campaign slug; representative value sample-campaign.
placeholder_inventory.prefix: Unique short campaign artifact prefix; representative value demo.

_template.companion_policy: Use accepted owning references and their compact exact-hash packet, never changing sibling bytes. Unaccepted companions remain PENDING. Final integration requires zero missing links and consistent fields, enums, authority, lifecycle, evidence and deadline meanings.
authority_and_lifecycle_rules: lifecycle records planning, admitted execution and completed delivery facts. Planning convergence is not execution authority or admission. Pause, cancellation/failure, ready-for-captain and captain acceptance are separate records. A fresh-session START ceremony, file existence or successful analysis grants no authority.

execution_admission.admitted remains false until actual mandate, sole owner/Run custody, immutable inputs, named base/topology, capabilities, permission scopes, models/loading, required readiness, native gate setup and finite bounds are reconciled. Unknown critical prerequisites block only their dependent path.

Amendment 1 selects roborev; models.review_engine and tasks[].review.engine name that provider, not its separately resolved execution_engine. Scoped existing qualification is retained with exact applicability evidence, not re-probed or inherited by other engines, auxiliary purposes or real candidates.

Amendment 2 removes the total campaign cutoff and permits three paid working agents and frozen previous-file review alongside independent next-file writing. It supersedes older fixed-cutoff/two-worker wording, not source independence, original attempt clocks, review bounds, spend, acceptance or retention. Other campaigns must replace these scoped grants with their actual mandate.

Intent precedes every mutation, including dispatch, steering, stop, abandon, release, integration, deletion and deadline changes. Preserve expected revision, mandate, exact target, original bounds and returned request/operation/retry identity; append sanitized result and reconcile uncertainty before repetition. An intent proves neither action nor non-action.

Native receipts own observed native operations; STATE owns decisions and evidence. Preserve contradictions and raw values instead of editing runtime databases. Unknown launch, stop, integration or timer outcome blocks duplicate actions; replay only the exact operation supported and instructed by its receipt.

Superseded Tasks remain historical, never PASS. Preserve original-to-replacement wiring and separate analysis delivery from acceptance. Source conflict resolution belongs to a scoped implementation worker, never the coordinator.
bound_and_progress_rules: Persist original attempt started_at, checkpoint_due_at and deadline_at before launch; actual_launch_observed_at may remain null while the prelaunch absolute deadline still binds. Attempt budget begins at actual launch but ambiguous submission cannot gain a renewed clock. Preserve all retry observations and original attempt history.

Fixes, retries, restarts, new sessions, model changes, repeated reads, transport churn and late receipts never reset clocks. Predeclared phase/review deadlines are finite and phase-specific, never a sliding extension of the slice. Workers stop source edits at their attempt deadline.

Before every affected dispatch, integration or gate completion, record actual UTC and check earliest applicable finite absolute deadline, authority/revision, pause, custody, source and exclusions. A null campaign cutoff is ignored only with evidenced absent_by_authority; unknown required bounds block admission. No new affected work after expiry.

At checkpoint inspect correlated structured semantic evidence and allow at most one scoped steer if needed. Preserve event time and observation time separately. last_observed_at, last_successful_assistant_at, last_completed_tool_at plus outcome, and last_semantic_progress_at prove different facts. Streams, PID, mtime, log growth, exit zero and ACP end_turn are not semantic progress or provider success.

Validate checkpoints against task/attempt/session/candidate, criterion, evidence/hash and UTC. Reject replayed IDs, future times, pre-baseline times, older checkpoints and superseded candidates. Errors do not refresh successful-step clocks; unknown/stale/truncated event schemas yield null health, not healthy. A live command within its deadline is not a stall.

Use native result/question/escalation wakes and exact-owner one-shot deadline reconciliation; save the pending continuation before waiting and end the turn. This JSON schedules nothing. No polling loop, external watcher, mailbox consumer or background supervisor. A queued wake is delayed reconciliation, not an exact-time barrier or proof of exit.

Only explicit authority permits a same-owner native continuity backstop, at most every 20 minutes in this campaign, disabled on terminal/pause/true needs-owner state. Reconcile saved operation identity before replacing a timer; remove only obsolete owned timers and ignore queued stale wakes.

Expiry stops admission and preserves partial source/evidence, not automatic acceptance, permanent feature FAIL, hard kill or restart. Operator pause never self-resumes. Archive late output under its original binding. Human-dependent input pauses the affected path without automatic retry.

At most two unproductive executions, one slice defect-fix round and two feature-integration fix rounds here. Useful findings are productive but do not waive clocks/fix caps. Keep native failed starts separate; their three-failed-start breaker is an additional ceiling, not a retry target. No new Task/Run to hide failed attempts.

Primary-model or permission failure stops the affected path for diagnosis. Changed-cause retry requires authority, remaining original bounds and positively reconciled predecessor custody. No silent provider/model switch, installation, permission weakening or global configuration change. Unsupported effort/token controls need explicit bounded spend reconciliation, not invented flags or claimed wall-time enforcement.
evidence_and_gate_rules: Every *_evidence_id and item in *_evidence_ids resolves uniquely through evidence to preserved exact path/SHA-256, revision, section, observation provenance and supported claim. Required null/unresolved pointers block eligibility. Hashes are lowercase 64-hex SHA-256; actual times are aware UTC. Private-record pointers need evidence-backed custody, not fabricated identities.

Source bindings cover repository/base/tip or explicit no-commit/unborn snapshot, exact source/test/dependency inventory, configuration/build/scenario identity, packet/diff and provenance. Binding comparison needs actual hashes, not merely matching nulls. No-commit routes leave unavailable commit fields null with explicit disposition.

Real runtime evidence exercises production paths and records scenario version/hash, commands, environment/build, expected and observed outcomes, exits and logs. Unit tests and synthetic tabletops do not substitute. Document-only tasks use assigned static receipts and independent exact-byte document verdicts; nonapplicable stages need reasoned dispositions, never runtime PASS.

Each real code candidate uses a fresh neutral separate reviewer context and immutable no-hooks review-only snapshot outside the live checkout. Preserve requested/resolved/actual model, qualified execution interface, effective configuration/tool-policy/packet/diff hashes and before/after source/config/hook guards. Read-only operational tools are not OS confinement.

Keep original live schema 3 JSON separate from rendered output and normalized decision. Retain sanitized provider stop/errors, final assistant JSON correspondence and every required tool result. External coverage must reconcile every required file to successful tool IDs, complete line ranges and returned content/hash, with explicit omissions and acceptance mapping. Roborev has no native coverage certificate.

No review yet is null. Drift marks evidence eligibility INVALIDATED while preserving the historical verdict and old binding. Missing, malformed, failed, partial, skipped, truncated, unknown, budget-stopped, contradictory, unmappable or zero-required-coverage evidence is INCONCLUSIVE. Valid complete fail or critical/high/medium acceptance/security finding is FAIL. Only valid pass plus complete nonzero coverage, provider/tool success, intact guards and provenance and no blocking findings permits PASS.

Preserve raw findings. Unknown severity is INCONCLUSIVE; confidence, kind or missing line positions cannot erase blockers. Independent closure owns disputed blockers; author/coordinator cannot waive them. Low/style alone does not create fixes. No routine second semantic code reviewer; required API inspection and runtime integration remain distinct.

A fix clears current eligibility and returns the task to in_progress before retest and fresh exact-candidate review. Review deduplication uses candidate/packet/scenario/run, not display status or a new commit. in_progress and in_review map only to optional display labels in-progress and in-review; neither is a verdict.

Each product successor depends on a separate coordinator-only acceptance Task. Required state is blocked, never ready or dispatched; raw unexpected native states remain in receipts and block admission. Creation-to-block setup keeps dispatch disabled and needs verified native evidence before graph activation. Only the designated coordinator may record blocked-to-completed after all required current bindings pass.

Code gate completion requires independent review, required API evidence, authorized integrated-source identity and actual post-integration smoke on that result. Document gates require assigned static results, preserved file/hash and independent exact-byte PASS. Successfully delivered FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE analysis, provider readiness, expiry and author self-review never release successors.

Integration requires prior intent, rechecked source/destination/UTC and authorized route. Squash receipts bind task tip, pre-squash destination, squash commit/tree; no-commit composition binds starting/incoming/result manifests, attributable diff including deletions/renames and complete untracked source. Lost results are reconciled, never blindly repeated; squash ancestry is not an idempotency test.

Final acceptance covers the exact complete source, integration seams and final independent review. Reconcile moved target and revalidate changed composition; verify expected named refs immediately before authorized final operation. Smoke actual target after authorized merge, or actual no-commit delivery snapshot with explicit no-target-merge disposition. Ready-for-captain is not captain acceptance.

Before disposal retain recoverable source/base, diff and untracked files, scenarios/build provenance, failures, raw review/coverage, integration and smoke in a verified checksummed archive outside every disposable worktree. Assignment settlement, physical exit and native release are separate receipts. Unknown custody/stop/release blocks replacement/reuse; dirty source is preserved or cleanup pauses. Keep deliberately retained resources visible, never mark them removed.
shape_rules: tasks[].attempt_history uses attempt_history; tasks[].remediation uses remediation; tasks[].history and top-level history use history. Preserve failed-start raw chain in immutable evidence referenced by failed_start_history; do not confuse it with completed executions.

tasks[].review.coverage.files uses review_coverage_files; tasks[].review.findings uses review_findings. review.history holds immutable evidence IDs for complete prior review records, including their original bindings and raw output. Never overwrite a historical FAIL or old PASS on drift.

source_binding describes the complete immutable binding behind current_candidate_binding_evidence_id, full_binding_evidence_id and stage binding pointers. Stage-specific results may be explicitly not_applicable only with required applicability evidence, not by leaving a necessary binding null.

final review and runtime evidence use the same full binding, completion, coverage and provenance contract as task review/runtime. final.requirements uses final_requirements. All final stage pointers resolve through the evidence registry; an empty requirements array is not final acceptance.

Preserve original native states verbatim in private receipts; normalized observations stay null on unknown/unrecognized values with an unknowns entry. A policy's required_state is not an observed native transition. No example task is pre-created and no native object is created by reading this template.

campaign_cutoff_authority.scope: Active full-auto campaign only; another campaign must replace this with its actual authority and cutoff disposition.
